english.note: Use this written-form equivalent when describing an especially intensified degree, such as being doubly careful.

examples.english: We need to be doubly careful so we do not make another mistake.
examples.traditional: 我哋要倍加小心，唔好再出錯。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 bui3 gaa1 siu2 sam1 m4 hou2 zoi3 ceot1 co3
